title: El quechua hoy: vitalidad lingüística y literatura andina
goal: Analyze the contemporary vitality of the Quechua language (Runa Simi), Arguedas's bilingual legacy, and youth Quechua urban music.
grammar: sociolingüística andina, morfología aglutinante del quechua y revitalización contemporánea

items: Explore the agglutinative precision and evidential suffixation of Runa Simi.
Analyze José María Arguedas's translation of Quechua poetic syntax into Spanish.
Deploy sociolinguistic, indigenous dignity, and bilingualism vocabulary (aglutinante, oralidad, dignificación, cosmovisión).
